atoms.text: Giacomo started to volunteer at the retirement home in his town. He really enjoys going there because he learns a lot from the older people living there. The people who live at the retirement home are also very pleased because Giacomo is like a breath of fresh air. He always has interesting stories to tell, plays the saxophone once a week and brings fun board games.
